author: kevandrades
quote: That's a remake 1:1, but a good remake because the original game was a good game. It updated and fixed the errors of the original. Good story, good gameplay, good level design, good OST, this game is timeless and will probably good even in the future.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: kevandrades
quote: Well, a good short game with good puzzles. Didn't look as good as the older Tomb Raider series. Lara's personality here seems to be forced and does not correspond to the gameplay. The game doesn't make you feel the weight of your decisions as it seems to want to. I was just killing people like it was normal, but I was expecting consequences and a feeling of being wrong the same way I feel with The Lasf of Us, for example. The realism is only aesthetic, but not emulate realistic feelings.

author: kevandrades
quote:
I played this game waiting for a game of beautiful girls with blades. And yea, definitely there are several beautiful girls with blades, BUT, this game is more. This game has an amazing soundtrack and a magnificent story, I just cried like a baby in the A2 ending. 

"I've never quite realized how beautiful this world is. I'm coming everyone, I AM COMING"

Gosh, the only thing I didn't like about this game is the 9S route, becase I just repeated the same missions in the same way, it could be different.

author: kevandrades
quote: Just loved it, the best GTA in terms of sandbox. Optimized enough, beautiful enough and crazy enough. No idea how Rockstar made this run on PS3.

author: kevandrades
quote: Didn't like the gameplay too much, but the storytelling and graphics are so good that I just ignored it and tried to follow the story. Several scenes made me sad in a way that I usually don't do with videogames. Extremely immersive and extremely alive. I'll never get over the scene with Joel in the hospital; it made me feel like a monster.

author: kevandrades
quote: I still remember when I was a child playing Counter Strike with my friends, and one of them said that CS was just a mod of Half-Life. So, I came to play this game and it feels like a revolution. I was seeing for the first time a way to interact with objects and destroying it, like the objects and materials has specific properties. Definitely a masterpiece.

author: kevandrades
quote: Definitely one of the best experiences in my whole life. The world of this game is builded to make it look alive, with or without you. It feels like the game is alive when you power it off, every single NPC has his own story, every single action has a consequence in the future. It's deep, and I'll think about this game for several years. This game is perfect, maybe the best game of all time.

author: kevandrades
quote: I am not a fan of souls likes, but I decided to give a chance for this game. Definitely an extremely beautiful game, loved the soundtrack and loved the gameplay itself. Tbh, I didn't like the storytelling, it's not really clear what is happening in this world and you need to discover it by yourself. Btw, nice game.

author: kevandrades
quote:
The game seems to have lost the essence of what GTA is, which has always been a sandbox where you can do anything in the craziest way possible. It's still possible to do that, but it feels like the game penalizes you when you do; it seems like they tried to steer the experience so that you DON'T do it, so that you don't play GTA as if it were GTA. They tried to make you play a Red Dead Redemption 2 under the GTA name, which would be good IF this game had a story as good as RDR2 (it doesn't, and it doesn't even come remotely close). I was also very bothered by the fact that, having had 13 years of development and a budget of over 2 billion, this game arrived with so many bugs, as there were several times when I simply sank into the scenery from absolute nowhere, and it seems that the characters' hitboxes don't match their visuals. Furthermore, it's absurd that, being so expensive, this game doesn't come with voice acting in multiple languages, and this greatly hinders the experience for those who are not native English speakers. This game disappointed me, and I eagerly awaited it. 

There are several options and content enough to have play for several months, lots of references and lots of easter eggs (as GTA usually do). I prefer GTA V, though, because it was still a GTA game. And one of the most beaufitul games I've saw too.
